newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean court approves arrest for Hanbo chairman.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean court approves arrest for Hanbo chairman.

text.p: A Seoul court on Friday issued an arrest warrant for the chairman of the troubled Hanbo Group whose steelmaking flagship crumbled in January, a court official said.
"The court has just approved the arrest warrant for Mr Chung Bo-keun," he said.

The prosecutors sought an arrest warrant earlier on Friday, accusing Chung of pocketing about 37 billion won ($41 million) from Hanbo Group funds. Hanbo, with 22 member firms, is South Korea's 14th-biggest industrial conglomerate.
Chung's father, Hanbo founder Chung Tae-soo, is standing trial along with nine other people in connection with a loans scandal that has rocked the nation.
Prosecutors reopened their investigation into the Hanbo scandal last Friday after the opposition attacked an earlier investigation as a whitewash which failed to bring major players to justice.
